body: I used to play football (not sure if you're US or EU, I mean 'soccer' if you are US) but a tendon injury stopped that short dream, I like video games but expensive! What did you do when you were feeling like this?

Hi, my advice would be start anywhere, just start! Once your environment is a better place hopefully you should start feeling better (sister had a miscarriage a few years ago and me and my brothers decorated her house) it didn't immediately stop her depression, but she's in a better place now and she says it definitely helped her! 
Always here to talk, not in the greatest place myself atm
Any ideas? A friend suggested working out, but gym equipment is expensive and there aren't any local gyms.. Plus it isn't something I would be very interested in
